verdict.rationale: Adyen is fundamentally API-first (Checkout, Platforms, payouts, reporting all documented as API calls) and even offers an MCP server for natural-language API access, but some functions like the visual Customer Area dashboard, reporting visualizations, and rule-builder UI for fraud rules are described as UI-based tools without confirmed full API parity. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all Customer Area/dashboard actions (rule builder, reporting visualizations, account management) have full API equivalents, independent hands-on verification of API completeness vs UI, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s).
